title: `_wethToRdnt()` will certainly revert as `rdntOut` is always zero
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  `BalancerPoolHelper._swap()` always returns `0` because it lacks a return statement or return parameter assignment. Hence, `rdntOut = poolHelper_.swapWethToRdnt(_wethIn, 0);` will always be 0, causing the slippage check to fail.  ## Recommendations  ```diff - IVault(vaultAddr).swap(singleSwap, funds, _minAmountOut, block.timestamp); + return IVault(vaultAddr).swap(singleSwap, funds, _minAmountOut, block.timestamp); ```
